texts: Fix thy gaze on the one far goal and let no voice turn thee; the heart that does not waver arrives.
My sister wanted to become a judge from age twelve, ignored every party and distraction through college, studied through illness, and last month she took her oath on the bench.
doha on staying focused on one goal no matter what, im preparing for civil services
one goal, no distraction

Write a doha about a person who sets one goal and gives everything to it, ignoring distractions and doubts, until the goal is reached, because a mind that does not scatter its strength cannot fail in the end.
After my husband's stroke, my mother-in-law decided he would walk again, and for two years she did not miss one hour of exercise with him, and this winter he walked to the end of the lane by himself.
I'd love a doha for someone who has lost many battles but keeps pursuing the same dream with unbroken focus, saying that the one who never lets go of his aim will finally see it fulfilled.
hold to the aim
doha for not giving up on my dream even after so many rejections, i just keep going
Though a hundred paths invite him, the true seeker has eyes for one; and that one, in time, becomes his own.
The moneylender counts but one coin until it is a thousand; so the single aim, pursued, grows great.

Write a doha about a poor young man who works with one aim to repay the moneylender and buy back his father's land, never straying from his purpose, until the debt is cleared and the land is his again.
My father borrowed from a moneylender to send me to college, and I swore I would clear every rupee, so I took no holidays and kept just one aim in mind for six years until it was done.
moneylender, debt, one aim
doha about a moneylender and sticking to one plan until the debt is paid
doha for my brother who is training for the olympics, he does nothing else in life
Single is the goal he follows and single is the path; the mind that has but one desire will reach.

I'd love a doha about the athlete who gives every hour of his day to a single dream, saying no to parties and comforts, because one-pointed devotion to a goal brings the victory that scattered effort cannot.
one-pointed training
My nephew has not been to a wedding or festival in four years because he trains from dawn to night for the national team, and he says it doesn't feel like sacrifice, it feels like direction.
doha w a sword - the swordsman trains for only one thing, the single focus is what makes him unbeatable

Write a doha about a swordsman who thinks of nothing but the single stroke he has to make, keeping his mind fixed on it until the sword itself seems to be guided by his focus, teaching that single-mindedness wins.
My grandfather, a fencing master, said that the sword follows the eye and the eye follows the will, and that he never let his gaze stray from his aim during all his years of training.
sword, single focus
The sword knows no master but the mind, and the mind that fixes on one stroke strikes true.
As one who aims at nothing else, the true seeker goes to his aim without a backward glance.
My mother learned to read at fifty because she wanted to read my letters from abroad herself, and she let nothing stop her, not eyesight, not shyness, not the jokes of neighbours.
doha about being obsessed with a goal in a good way, i wont stop until i finish my thesis
until it is done

Please write a doha for a determined person who has made up his mind to reach a goal and refuses every distraction, saying that a firm resolve, held without wavering, is stronger than any obstacle on the path.
doha on being laser focused, my exams are in two weeks and i have to ignore everything
Close thy ear to the thousand calls; the heart that listens to one voice walks straight.
My roommate switched off his phone, stopped meeting friends and studied twelve hours a day for six months, and then topped the entrance exam, which none of us believed possible.

Write a doha about learning to ignore all the pleasant distractions of life when there is one important goal ahead, because the single-minded student passes what the scattered mind will never even approach.
focus, ignore distractions
The churn goes round with one rhythm and one purpose, and the butter must come; so does the one-minded heart find its goal.

My aunt churned for hours every day without once looking up at the noise outside, and when I asked how she could be so focused she said you simply decide that nothing else exists till the butter comes.

Give me a doha in which the churn is turned steadily by a woman who keeps her mind fixed on one purpose, never stopping at the sound of any distraction, until the butter comes, teaching that persistent focus brings results.
churn, steady focus
doha w a churn - u keep churning with full focus till the butter appears, same with goals
Write a doha about how the touchstone tests the metal again and again until the true one is found, just as the single-minded seeker tries and tries until the one aim of his heart is reached.
touchstone, relentless testing
My grandfather, a jeweller, would rub a piece on the touchstone a hundred times until he was certain, and he said that anyone who wants one thing with all his heart will not stop until he gets it.
The touchstone does not tire of its testing, nor the seeker of his search; both are bound to the one thing.
doha w a touchstone - keep testing and trying, never stop until u find the real thing
spinning wheel, one aim
doha w a spinning wheel: spins and spins with one goal, the yarn, and nothing else exists for her
The spinning wheel hums its one song, and the spinner's mind sits in it; so grows the great work from a single focus.

My great aunt spun yarn for the independence movement with total devotion, on her wheel day and night, and when asked why she never took a break she said she had only one thought and it never left her.

Write a doha about the spinner at her spinning wheel whose entire mind is bound to one purpose, the finished length of yarn, for her unwavering attention makes every motion perfect and every hour productive.
beggar's single hope

Write a doha about a beggar who sits at one spot day after day with a single hope in his heart, never moving, until the day his persistence is rewarded, teaching the power of staying fixed on one aim.
The beggar sits at the one spot and asks the one gift; he who changes his place receives nothing.
doha w a beggar - he stays at one spot and asks for one thing till he gets it, its about not changing ur goal
A beggar at our station asked only for the fare to reach his village and for months took not a coin for any other purpose, and one day a stranger gave him the sum, and he left that night.
The bier is carried; the thorn pricks the foot; yet the pilgrim who has one aim keeps walking.
At my father's funeral, a thorn caught my foot and made it bleed, but I did not stop walking behind the bier because I had promised him that I would be there at the end, no matter what.
Write a doha about a pilgrim whose feet bleed from thorns and who stumbles past a bier, yet keeps walking to his one destination, teaching that a single aim held firmly makes all hardships small.
doha w a thorn and a bier - even with thorns in his foot and death all around, he keeps going to his goal
thorn, bier, onward
fly, relentless buzzing
A fly kept hitting the glass for an hour until it found the gap at the top, and my father said, that is what you call focus, and made me go back to my homework.
The fly strikes the glass and strikes again; it asks only one thing, and it never tires.
doha w a fly - it keeps trying the same opening till it gets out, relentless
Write a doha about a small fly that keeps flying at the same opening again and again, never giving up on its one aim until it passes through, teaching that stubborn focus conquers every barrier.
The stream knows one thing, the ocean, and runs to it without rest; so run thou to thy aim.
A boy who grew up in a tiny village decided to study oceanography, and for twelve years he gave up everything else, saved every rupee, and today he leads research on the ocean floor.
doha w an ocean - streams just keep going to the ocean no matter what, i want that focus
Could you do a doha about the stream that, with its eyes fixed on the ocean, runs past every obstacle without stopping or turning, teaching that a heart with a single aim will reach it?
ocean, unwavering aim
unbroken determination

Write a doha for a student who has failed an important exam three times and is tempted to give up, saying that those who keep their mind fixed on the target and rise each time they fall finally reach it.
Fall seven times and rise the eighth, with eyes still on the one far thing; that is the lover of his goal.
My uncle failed the bar exam five times, working at a petrol pump in between, and on the sixth attempt he passed with distinction, and he says he never once considered another career.
doha on determination, failed my driving test 3 times but gonna try again
doha w gold - the goldsmith keeps hammering the one piece of gold until its perfect, no other work
gold, single-minded craft

Write a doha about a goldsmith who fixes his whole mind on one piece of gold, working at it day after day without turning to any other task, until it shines perfectly, teaching the power of undivided focus.
The goldsmith bends to one piece of gold with all his soul, and the hour forgets him as he works.

My neighbour spent two years making a single necklace of gold for his daughter's wedding, refusing all other orders in the meantime, and the piece was so perfect that it was shown in the district fair.
The yogi sits at the well's edge with eyes on one point; the water rises to the one who waits with such a mind.

Please give me a couplet about a yogi who sits beside a well and fixes his mind on a single point, never wandering, until knowledge rises within him, showing that a concentrated mind attains what a wandering mind never will.
The old yogi who sits by the village well said that when his mind drifts he just brings it back to one point, thousands of times a day, and that is the whole of his practice.
doha w a yogi and a well - he keeps his mind on one point and that is how deep things get found
yogi, well, one-pointed mind
By the furnace and the cremation ground he works, and the one thought of his heart keeps him upright.
My brother works at a furnace job near the cremation ground, and he saves every paisa for his sister's wedding, never wasting any on himself, and he says the thought of her wedding keeps his focus.
Write a doha about a man who works at the furnace beside the cremation ground, holding on to one purpose in his heart, so that neither heat nor sorrow turns him from the work he has set himself.
doha w a furnace and a cremation ground, he works there with one goal and nothing breaks him
furnace, cremation ground, resolve
I started a restaurant, a podcast, a clothing brand and a book all in one year, and by December none of them had worked, and my wife said, you have to pick one thing and stay with it.
Who chases many aims reaches none; choose thy one desire and give it all thy strength.
pick one, stay with it

Write a doha for someone who has too many interests and ambitions, urging them to choose one aim and give all their effort to it, because the man who chases ten goals reaches none, while the one-aimed man always arrives.
doha on choosing one thing and sticking to it, i have too many projects going on
The bee has eyes for but one flower and the whole garden may call; it sips that one to the end.
doha w a bee - it keeps to one flower, one aim, nothing distracts it
I'd love a doha about the bee that fixes on a single flower and ignores all others in the garden, going on until it is done, to show that focus on one aim, held firmly, brings the sweetest result.
My daughter followed the same bee around the garden for an hour as it hovered over just one bloom, and she said she wants to be like that when she studies for her finals.
bee, one flower
The traveller's eye is on the diamond far ahead; he sees not the heat or the dust, only the one bright aim.

Give me a doha about a traveller crossing wastes and valleys with his mind set on one diamond that awaits him, refusing every temptation along the way, teaching that unswerving focus brings a person to his treasure.
doha w a traveller and a diamond, he keeps going to the diamond no matter what happens on the way
traveller, diamond, onward
My cousin travelled across three countries to attend a rare diamond-cutting course, enduring poor hostels and long hours, and said all that mattered was the thing waiting at the end.
A fly kept circling the market stall and wouldn't stop trying to get at the sweets, and I thought that is what dedication looks like, even if it is a nuisance.
doha w a fly and a market - the fly just keeps to the same thing in the middle of the market chaos, thats focus lol
Write a doha about a fly that ignores all the noise and crowd of the market and pursues one single thing without stopping, teaching that even the humblest creature shows what unswerving focus can do.
In the clamour of the market the fly hears one call only; so should the seeker hear his own.
fly, market, one purpose
One seed, one needle, one purpose: the sower lays his hope into the ground and waits with unshaken eyes.
seed, needle, one purpose
My grandmother stitched a tiny embroidery of a seed pod for six months with one needle, refusing every other job, and the finished piece won the state prize.
doha w a seed and a needle, u pick one tiny goal and stitch it patiently till done

Write a doha about a gardener who plants a single seed and a seamstress who works a single needle, both unwavering in their one purpose, teaching that great things come from a single point of full attention.
beggar's one request
doha w a beggar - he knows what he wants and doesn't ask for anything else, total focus
Write a doha about a beggar who, when offered a hundred things, asks only for the one thing he came for, teaching that those who know their single aim are not distracted by lesser gifts.
The beggar before the throne of kings asks the single boon; offered the world, he does not turn.
At the village fair a beggar was offered sweets, clothes and coins, but he said he wanted only the bus fare to his sister, and he would not be turned from it by anything else.
My friend gave up cricket, films and trips for three years to earn enough to buy back the gold bangles his mother had pawned, and today they sit on her wrists again.
gold, one aim
A doha, please, about a son who gives up every luxury for years with one aim in mind, to redeem his mother's gold, teaching that unshakeable focus on a single purpose can recover what seemed lost.
One aim lives in the heart, the gold of the mother's hand; for it all pleasures are laid aside.
doha w gold - he saves for years for one goal to get his moms gold back

Write a doha about a labourer who builds a bridge plank by plank across a wide gap with one aim of reaching the far side, never stopping through years of toil, teaching that a single purpose finishes the greatest work.
Plank upon plank he lays the bridge, and his eyes are on the far bank; the unbroken aim makes the road.
doha w a bridge - one guy builds it by himself over years cuz he wants to reach the other side
bridge, years of building
A farmer in our district spent twenty-two years building a bridge across the gap in the valley so his village could reach the school, ignoring all mockery, and today every child crosses it.
doha on single minded dedication to a career goal, i work 14 hours daily for my startup
My cousin built his company from nothing, working sixteen hours a day, sleeping in the office, thinking of nothing but one product, and the investors finally came to him.

Write a doha for an entrepreneur who gives up leisure, holidays and distractions to chase a single venture with total dedication, reminding him that great things are built by those whose whole mind is on one thing.
all-in on one goal
He who has only one love in his heart will build a kingdom from nothing; the divided heart builds nothing.
doha: tune out the noise and keep ur eyes on the goal, everyone is telling me to quit
Need a doha for the person whose friends and family all mock his dream and tell him to quit, saying that the one who keeps his eyes fixed on his aim, deaf to ridicule, finally silences the critics.
ignore the critics
Let the world say what it will; the heart with one aim hears only its own call.
Everybody in my family told me to give up painting and get a stable job, and I did not, I just kept working on my one aim, and last month my first exhibition sold out.

Write a doha for a mother who fights for years to get justice for her wronged son, going from office to office with unwavering resolve, teaching that a single determined purpose can move even the hardest authority.
One mother, one cause, a thousand offices: she knocks at all, and the last one opens.
My neighbour went to forty-three government offices over six years to prove her son's innocence, and when the court finally cleared him, she said she had never once doubted the outcome.
doha about a mom who never stops fighting for her kid, pure determination
mother's relentless fight

At the village wedding the palanquin bearers carried the bride for twelve miles over rough ground with the oil press owner's cart behind, determined to arrive before sunset, and they did, never once slowing down.
palanquin, oil press, determination

Write a doha in which the bearers of a palanquin carry their load over every difficulty with one goal, and the oil press turns steadily in the village, both showing how focus on a single task delivers results.
doha w a palanquin and an oil press - both just keep going at their one job until its done
The palanquin moves toward the one village, the oil press turns toward its one drop; both bound to the single task.
churn, cuckoo, dedication

Could you do a doha about the cuckoo that calls out to the season without ceasing and the churn that turns without rest until butter comes, both teaching that unswerving dedication to a single task yields the fruit.
doha w a cuckoo and a churn - one keeps calling, one keeps turning, both until they get what they want
My grandmother churned in the morning to the call of a cuckoo that sat on the same branch every day, and she said both of them knew that persistence is what brings the result.
The cuckoo calls, the churn goes round; neither asks the hour, both are faithful to the one aim.
A man in our village spent eleven years turning the grindstone in his father's place to pay for his sister's studies, never complaining, never looking at another path, and she is now a doctor.
doha w a grindstone - he turns it for years for one reason, his sisters education

Write a doha about a man who turns the grindstone daily for years with one single purpose in his heart, caring for his family, unmoved by any temptation to leave the task, teaching that the strength of purpose shapes destiny.
Round and round the grindstone goes, and with it turns the one thought of the heart; this is how a man makes his fate.
grindstone, one purpose
My uncle spent his whole life researching a rare medicinal herb, a real paras for the sick, giving up wealth and comfort, and in his last year he finally discovered it.
doha w the paras - he spends his life looking for it and doesnt stop for anything else
The paras is sought by the single-hearted, who walk through the years with no eyes for lesser things.

Write a doha about a seeker who devotes his entire life to finding the paras, refusing wealth, comfort and distraction, teaching that those who dedicate themselves wholly to a single aim at last attain it.
paras, lifelong quest

My sister is an astrophysicist who spent ten years looking at one faint signal, and when the data finally confirmed it, she said that the long years had never once felt wasted, because she had only one question.

Please write a doha about a scientist who spends many years on one hard question, undistracted by fame, money or any easier work, teaching that the mind fixed on a single question will eventually find the answer.
One question lit within him, and he followed it through years of silence; and the answer came to the faithful.
doha on research and how obsession with one problem leads to a breakthrough
one question, many years
eyes on the target
One hand that does not shake is enough; hold thy gaze upon the mark and let the noise go by.
doha about keeping eyes on the target, i have an interview and cant be distracted

I'd love a doha about a competitor who looks at nothing but his target, deaf to the crowd's cheers and jeers, reminding every seeker that the person who keeps his gaze fixed on a single mark will certainly reach it.
Before my big presentation, my coach told me to look at one point on the back wall and ignore everyone in the hall, and that one trick helped me deliver without stammering.

Write a doha about the swan that glides on without distraction and the fish that swims upstream with its one aim, both teaching that those who keep their eyes on one goal are carried across every obstacle.
swan, fish, one direction
doha w a swan and a fish, one goes across the lake, the other upstream, both only care about their own path
The swan moves toward the far shore; the fish leaps against the current; both are given to one direction.
At the college lake I watched a swan glide steadily across while a fish pushed against the stream beneath, and my teacher said, that is what we ask of you at exam time.
rope, climbing on
Write a doha about a climber who ascends a rope hand over hand, eyes only on the top, never looking down, teaching that the person who is fixed on his goal rises above every danger.
Hand over hand upon the rope he climbs, and his eyes are on the top; nothing else exists for him.
doha w a rope - he climbs it hand over hand with only the top in mind, dont look down
At our school sports day a small boy climbed the rope to the top for the first time, never once looking at the cheering crowd below, and our teacher said that is how one reaches anything.
My grandmother walked to the temple every day for forty years to pray for her son's return and offered jaggery each time, and the day he returned she was at the same step.

Give me a doha about a devotee who brings an offering of jaggery to the temple daily for one single wish, never changing his prayer, teaching that steadfast focus on one desire is the surest path to its fulfilment.
doha w jaggery and a temple - she goes every day with the same offering for the same wish until it comes true
The jaggery at the temple steps, the same wish at the same hour; such faith turns the heavens.
jaggery, temple, one wish
The spinning wheel and the moneylender's debt, both known to the weaver who spun her one wish into every hour of the day.
spinning wheel, moneylender, debt
My great grandmother spun on the spinning wheel for the moneylender for twenty years until the whole family's debt was cleared, with her mind on just that one thing.

Write a doha about a weaver who sits at her spinning wheel with one aim, to clear her family's debt to the moneylender, and works day and night without wavering until it is paid, teaching the strength of single-minded purpose.
doha w a spinning wheel and a moneylender, she spins to clear the debt and never gives up
doha w a skeleton: even when hes nothing but a skeleton, hes still going after his one goal, thats dedication

Write a doha about a man so fixed on his purpose that he works without food or sleep until he is thin as a skeleton, teaching that when the mind holds one goal the body follows, and resolve is rewarded.
Though he grows lean as a skeleton, the one thought in his heart is stout; this is the lover of his goal.
skeleton-thin, still going
My uncle trained so hard for his black belt, skipping meals and sleep, that he looked like a skeleton by the end, but he got his belt and says he never once felt tempted to quit.
The old sword master said the blade must be as unwavering as a heron's gaze at the water, and he taught us to focus on a single point until we nearly forgot to blink.

A doha, please, about a swordsman who learns from a heron standing motionless with its gaze fixed on one point, so that he strikes with perfect aim, teaching that the focused mind is the sharpest weapon.
sword, heron's gaze
The heron's eye is on one spot, and the sword is swung in the same spirit; the unwavering gaze wins.
doha w a sword and a heron - the heron stares at one spot and the swordsman learns from that kinda focus
The peacock dances for one season and has but one thought: the sky that gathers. Single is his joy.
doha w a peacock, he dances for the rain and no other thing exists
My niece practised her peacock dance for her school function for months with total concentration, ignoring TV and friends, and when she danced, the whole hall fell silent.

Write a doha about the peacock that waits and dances only for the season that matters, giving its whole spirit to that single purpose, teaching that complete absorption in one thing brings the rarest beauty.
peacock, total absorption
doha w a cage and crossroads: bird in a cage ignores the crossroads outside and keeps trying to get free, one aim
A bird trapped in a cage near the crossroads in my town kept pecking at one bar for days, never giving up, until the vendor took pity and freed it, and I thought that is a lesson in focus.
cage, crossroads, single aim
Write a doha about a caged bird at the crossroads that works at the same spot day after day with one aim of freedom, teaching that one fixed purpose will in the end break through any prison.
Though a hundred roads call from the crossroads, the caged bird wants only one: the open sky.

Need a doha for a person who is recovering from a serious illness and wants to walk again, telling them that a single goal, pursued every day with determination, will bring healing where doubt only brings despair.
After the accident my friend was told he'd never walk, but he set the goal to attend his sister's wedding standing up, and with that one thought he rebuilt his legs in fourteen months.
One wish before the heart, one step before the foot; and the one step becomes the journey.
goal-driven recovery
doha for recovery from surgery, i just have to focus on walking again
When the heart is set on one thing, the world makes way; the single mind is a path unto itself.

Write a doha for a writer who is working on one great book and refuses all other offers and temptations, saying that the person who gives his whole attention to a single work will see it finished and recognised.
one book, full attention
doha for writers, finish the one book and dont get distracted by new ideas
My uncle wrote a single novel for eighteen years, refusing every other project and job offer, and when it came out last spring it won a national prize.
Seek one thing and seek it wholly; the divided heart arrives nowhere.
wholehearted pursuit
My friend decided to master Sanskrit grammar, and for nine years she turned down parties, trips and relationships, saying she had only one task, and today she teaches at a university.
doha: go all in on one thing and finish it

Write me a doha that praises the one who throws his whole self into a single pursuit, without holding back or hedging his bets, saying that wholehearted devotion to one aim brings what half-hearted efforts never do.
washerman, relentless scrubbing
The washerman at our ghat scrubs each stain until it is gone, no matter how long it takes, and my mother says he has taught her more about persistence than any book.
doha w a washerman - he scrubs one stain till its gone, dont stop till its done
The washerman scrubs the one stain till it is gone, and heeds not the hour; so work thou at thy aim.
Write a doha about a washerman who will not rest until the last stain is lifted from the cloth, teaching that an unyielding focus on a single task brings it to a clean and perfect finish.
doha: stay focused on ur goals and dont let the setbacks stop u
Though the way be long, the resolute walk it; and the goal grows near by the very walking.
stay the course
Our mountaineering club member lost his toes to frostbite on his first attempt, but he returned the next year for the same summit, saying that nothing could make him give up that one dream.
I'd like a doha that tells people to stay on course toward their goals despite setbacks and delays, since the person with a firm purpose treats each obstacle as a signpost and not as a wall.
aim fixed, heart fixed
Let the heart point steadily to one aim; no wind shall turn it.

Please write a doha that celebrates the person of unwavering resolve whose aim never changes through years of difficulty, saying that the steadfast heart, once set on its purpose, will not be turned by praise, blame or fear.
When my grandfather decided to educate every child in our village, he faced threats and mockery for thirty years, but never once changed his aim, and today the school bears his name.
doha about a person who wont change his goal no matter what ppl say
fish, crossroads, one path
At the crossroads of the stream the fish chooses one way and swims on; he who wavers at the fork is carried off.
The fish in the pond near our college always swim toward the same corner at the crossroads of the paths, and my professor told us that a decision once made must be pursued without looking back.
doha w a fish and crossroads, fish just picks one way and swims on without second guessing

Could you do a doha about a fish that comes to a crossroads in the water and chooses one direction, swimming on without a backward glance, teaching that decision followed by unwavering pursuit is what carries one to the goal.
